question_design: One source-first abstract passage per local paper. Gold passages were checked against their own ingested PDFs before retrieval. Human query, expected-answer, and claim-to-citation review remains pending; lexical overlap may favor BM25.
confidence_interval_note: Recall@10 hybrid 95% CI [0.378, 0.689]. compare_retrievers intervals are candidate-vs-dense; do not interpret them as a BM25-vs-hybrid interval.
latency_note: Measured locally on CPU in separate runs; indicative only and hardware-dependent.
note: Current 45-paper, 1,686-chunk showcase index and 45-question source-first set. Retrieval metrics only; answer faithfulness and citation entailment have not been human-reviewed.
